# Provide the product runtime interface

## Goal

Make the product startable through runtime protocol v1.

## Dependencies

- None

## Obligations

- The product can be started through its `product.toml` manifest.
- It listens on the host and port supplied by the runner.
- It publishes a self-contained OpenAPI 3.1 document as JSON at the manifest path.
